about: Ready-made flow nodes for a relay vault (contracts/relay; its rules live in the shared brain, contracts/brain). Every request goes through the vault's `x` door as `{"<method>": <args>}` (e.g. x {"save_flow": {name, nodes}}); views are the brain's, with the vault named (e.g. brain.get_flow({vault, flow_id})). Each `recipe` is saved as a node's `action`; `${...}` are filled in by the canvas or the agent; `{amount}`, `{min_out}`, `{scaled}`, `{owner}`, `{vault}` are filled in by the brain at run time. `trust` lists what the vault must trust (x {"trust": {add, remove}}) for the node to run. `tested` names the test that runs this recipe against real code, or says it isn't tested in a flow yet.

nodes.label: Swap on Rhea

params.min_out_per_in: least output per input, scaled 1e24 (slippage guard)

actions.label: Swap via NEAR Intents
actions.kind: vault action (not a recipe), OWNER ONLY: the brain builds the vault's own token_diff intent, the vault MPC-signs it
actions.setup: x {"intents_setup": {verifier, signer}} once; x {"intents_allow": {"pair": {token_in, token_out, max_in, floor_out, floor_per_in, market?}}}
actions.call: x {"intents_sign_swap": {token_in, token_out, amount_in, min_out, valid_secs}} -> returns the signed intent (event intents_signed); a solver matches and submits execute_intents
actions.guards: only allowed pairs; amount <= max_in and the spending limit 'intents:<token>'; minimum = max(min_out, owner floor); salt read from the verifier; withdrawals only to the vault
actions.tested: sandbox/tests/intents.rs (real intents.near v0.4.5 wasm); LIVE testnet: intvault.nf-owner-ksleb.testnet on verifier.tidepool-sandbox.testnet, real MPC signature, settled tx EDqZApU7fKJwx5S3F1mYndztvnjMx1mc7TFnvAqcbghj

actions.label: Swap on Solana via Jupiter
actions.kind: vault action, OWNER ONLY: the brain checks every byte of a Jupiter message, then the vault MPC-signs it (Ed25519)
actions.setup: x {"sol_setup": {signer, max_cu_price, max_cu_limit}}; x {"sol_allow": {"pair": {in_mint, out_mint, max_in, min_out_per_in_e12}}}
actions.call: x {"sol_sign_swap": {message}} -> event sol_signed {signature}; helper: scripts/keeper `npm run jupiter` (simulates; --broadcast to send)
actions.guards: solguard: one signer (the vault), no lookup tables, only ComputeBudget/ATA/Jupiter v1 routes, proceeds to the vault's own accounts, no platform fee, floor after slippage, size and fee caps
actions.tested: contracts/solguard (synthetic attacks + real Jupiter txs), sandbox/tests/sol.rs; LIVE: solvault.nf-keeper-ksleb.testnet, real MPC signature over a live Jupiter route, verified; Jupiter is mainnet-only so not broadcast; EXECUTED on a Solana mainnet fork (surfpool, with a full vault before relay vaults): live testnet vault + real MPC signature, 0.1 USDC -> 0.0011 SOL

actions.label: Any EVM call from a template (Uniswap v3/v4, Aave, StonkBrokers Smart LP and pair tokens, Permit2, approvals)
actions.kind: vault action, OWNER ONLY (a keeper signs on other chains only through remote flow nodes): the brain BUILDS the call from an owner-set template (contract + function + a rule per argument), then the vault MPC-signs it (secp256k1)
actions.setup: x {"evm_setup": {signer, chain_id, max_fee, max_tip, gas_cap}}; x {"evm_template": {"template": {name, to, function, args: rule tree [fixed|vault|at_most|floor|market|share|same|deadline|bytes|encoded|tuple|list], value, spends}}}; ready-made Base and Robinhood Chain templates in nodes/evm-templates.json
actions.call: x {"evm_call": {name, values, nonce, max_fee, max_tip, gas}} -> event evm_signed {raw}; broadcast with eth_sendRawTransaction
actions.guards: addresses are fixed or the vault itself (no rule lets a caller pick one); bytes fixed or nested encodings with the same rules; amounts capped; minimums = max(quote, amount x num / den), and with 'market' also >= the oracle's price for the amount less slippage (every library swap: Base WETH -> USDC, the v4 ETH <-> NVDA swaps, NVDA confirmed by its USDG pool's 30-min TWAP), with 'share' the same for an LP share priced from its two tokens' feeds and the owner's pinned k (the ETHNVDA zap and redeem, Smart LP deposit and withdraw); deadlines = block time + 5 min (rule 'deadline'); repeated amounts and attached ETH tied with 'same'; spending limits 'evm:<chain>:<token>' and 'evm:<chain>:eth'; gas caps; low-s
actions.tested: sandbox/tests/evm.rs (templates vs the viem-checked encoder, 13 refusals); sandbox/tests/evm_fork.rs EXECUTED on a Base mainnet fork: Uniswap 0.1 WETH -> ~222 USDC, Aave supply 445 USDC -> aUSDC and withdraw back. Earlier LIVE: real MPC-signed Sepolia swap (pre-template code); sandbox/tests/evm_fork_robinhood.rs EXECUTED on a Robinhood Chain fork: StonkBrokers' audited Smart LP sdAMZN-FR-USDG zapDeposit 50 USDG -> 5.58e6 share-wei, zapWithdraw -> 49.80 USDG (0.4% round trip), each at the brain's share floor; Uniswap v4 via Universal Router (ETH -> NVDA -> ETH, Permit2) at the market floor, a pool 5% off the market refused, and the ETHNVDA pair token (zap 0.01 ETH -> 0.0169 shares -> 0.0098 ETH) at its share floor, executed on the Robinhood fork; ladder_fork_robinhood.rs runs the whole NVDA ladder there with market and share floors; ABI encoder checked against Foundry

actions.label: A flow node on another chain (EVM or Solana template)
actions.kind: flow node: Recipe.remote instead of calls; the brain checks the trigger and puts the node's own input in the template, the vault signs; the keeper broadcasts and reports the output
actions.setup: evm_setup / sol_setup and the templates; oracle_setup for price triggers (all through x); x {"save_flow": {name, nodes}} with nodes whose action is {calls: [], out: null, remote: {call: {chain: 'evm', template, amount_leaf, min_leaf, deadline_leaf} | {chain: 'sol', template, amount_field, min_field}, out: 'evm:<chain>:<token|eth>' | 'sol:<mint>', max_out_per_in, max_out, price: {feed, quote}}}; x {"fund": {flow_id, node, amount}} takes the owner's word for remote balances
actions.call: x {"step_remote": {flow_id, node, args: {chain: 'evm', values, nonce, max_fee, max_tip, gas} | {chain: 'sol', message}, reveal, salt}} -> events remote_step {amount, min_out, max_out, expires_ns} and evm_signed / sol_signed; after broadcast: x {"remote_report": {flow_id, node, out}} (out null = failed)
actions.guards: trigger checked by the brain (time from the block, price from the oracle: fresh, tight, confirmed; never a keeper number); amount = the node's inbox/chunk, whatever the keeper sends; the amount leaf must spend the node's own token; EVM deadline filled by the brain (block time + 5 min); EVM nonce: the keeper must use the vault's next one (no signing ahead, no reuse; the owner may use any), fee = the owner's cap; Solana: exactly one instruction of the node's template, others may not spend, amount field = the node's input, no durable nonce (the tx dies with its blockhash); output CAPPED AND FLOORED, NOT MEASURED: a report must be >= the signed minimum and <= max_out_per_in x input / max_out; only the owner may report a signed step failed (out null frees the input: a keeper's word could spend it twice); one step in flight per flow; spending limits; hidden flows via reveal + salt
actions.tested: sandbox/tests/remote.rs (NVDA ladder on mock Pyth: rungs fire only at their oracle price, stale price refused, out-of-bounds reports refused, failure timing, pause after 3, wrong-token wiring and limits refused, hidden nodes; Solana LP-fee sweep into a memecoin buy); sandbox/tests/ladder_fork_robinhood.rs EXECUTED on a Robinhood Chain fork: 0.03 ETH -> 0.3496 NVDA, sold a third at each of $275 / $365 / $545 -> 0.02946 ETH, zapped into 0.0497 ETHNVDA shares; fork balances equal the ledger

actions.label: Hop out of NEAR Intents to the vault's own address on Solana or an EVM chain (POA bridge)
actions.kind: flow node (relay vaults / the brain): Recipe.remote with call {chain: 'hop'}; the brain builds the bridge withdrawal itself, the keeper reports what landed
actions.setup: intents_setup(verifier, signer); sol_setup and/or evm_setup (the vault's own addresses there); intents_hop({hop: {token: '<chain>[-<id>].omft.near', chain: 'sol' | 'evm', max, max_fee}}); save_flow with a node {input: 'intents:<token>', action: {calls: [], out: null, remote: {call: {chain: 'hop'}, out: 'sol:<SOL|mint>' | 'evm:<chain id>:<eth|token>'}}}; fund(flow, node, amount) on the owner's word (the Intents balance is checked by the verifier when it runs)
actions.call: step_remote({flow_id, node, args: {chain: 'hop'}}) -> the vault calls intents.near ft_withdraw {token, receiver_id: token, amount, memo: 'WITHDRAW_TO:<the vault's own address>'} (1 yocto, 60 Tgas) -> events hop, remote_step, hop_sent (or hop_failed + step_failed, input back to the node); when it lands: remote_report({flow_id, node, out}) (scripts/keeper `npm run hop -- status <near tx> <token> --wait`). One-off, outside flows (owner only, like the other direct doors): intents_hop_out({token, amount})
actions.guards: the destination is never an argument: the brain builds it from the vault's own Solana / EVM address; only POA tokens the owner allowed ('<label>.omft.*', sol to Solana, eth/base/arb/gnosis/bera/hood to EVM), and the node's output must be on that token's chain; amount <= the hop's max and the spending limit 'intents:<token>'; report between amount - max_fee and amount (same decimals both sides); a sent hop can only be called failed by the owner (no deadline: burned tokens come back only through the bridge); ft_withdraw stays out of recipes and act; the node runs by owner or keeper (step_remote), the one-off by the owner
actions.tested: sandbox/tests/hop.rs against the real intents.near verifier (v0.4.5) and BOTH token codes fetched from mainnet today: base.omft.near (POA token: burns, memo on ft_burn) and sol.omft.near (Omni Bridge omni-token 0.4.3: hands the transfer to the bridge's withdraw relayer); 1.5 SOL and 0.25 Base ETH out to the vault's own addresses with the keeper's own address ignored; over-cap, spending limit, stranger, wrong landing chain, out-of-bounds reports, refused withdrawal refunded. The bridge's off-chain payout itself isn't run (mainnet only).

actions.label: Hop into NEAR Intents from the vault's own Solana or EVM address (SOL, USDC on Solana; ETH, USDC on Base; ETH, USDG on Robinhood Chain)
actions.kind: templates (relay vaults / the brain): a transfer to the vault's own Intents deposit address, pinned by the owner; usable one-off by the owner (sol_sign_tx / evm_call) or by the keeper as a remote flow node (step_remote: Solana amount_field 0, EVM amount_leaf 0), e.g. right after a hop node to close the round trip
actions.setup: the owner looks up the vault's deposit address once: `npm run hop -- deposit-address <vault> sol:mainnet | eth:8453 | eth:4663` (bridge API deposit_address; one 0x address for every EVM chain); then sol_template(intents_deposit_sol {deposit_address, max_lamports}) / sol_template(intents_deposit_usdc {deposit_usdc_account: the deposit address's USDC account, which must exist, max_units}) from nodes/sol-templates.json, evm_template(intents_deposit_eth {deposit_address, max_wei}) / evm_template(intents_deposit_usdc | intents_deposit_usdg {deposit_address, max_units}) from nodes/evm-templates.json intents_deposits
actions.call: Solana: sol_sign_tx({message}) with the System transfer / SPL TransferChecked (keeper helper: scripts/keeper/src/fork-sol.ts pay-sol, pay-spl); EVM: evm_call({name: 'intents_deposit_eth', values: [amount], ...}) (a plain transfer: no calldata) or ({name: 'intents_deposit_usdc', values: [0, amount], ...}); the bridge credits the vault's Intents account (`npm run hop -- deposits <vault> <chain>`)
actions.guards: the recipient is fixed in the template (no rule lets a keeper name one): the vault signs a transfer to the pinned deposit address and nothing else; amounts capped; spending limits 'sol:SOL', 'sol:<mint>', 'evm:<chain>:<token>'; a plain EVM transfer has no arguments and an at_most value; the bridge's minimum deposit applies (SOL 0.00125)
actions.tested: sandbox/tests/hop_fork.rs EXECUTED on a Base mainnet fork (owner one-offs: 0.03 ETH as a plain transfer and 20 USDC to the pinned address; keeper and stranger at the direct door, over-cap, no template refused, a recipient in the fixed leaf ignored; the keeper's flow Intents -> hop 0.02 Base ETH to the vault's own address -> what landed back to the deposit address, at the vault's next nonce) and a Solana mainnet fork (0.2 SOL and 20 USDC to the pinned address and its USDC account; transfers anywhere else, the same message with the address swapped, over-cap and past the spending limit refused, nothing signed; the keeper's flow Intents -> hop 0.1 SOL to the vault's own address -> exactly what landed back to the deposit address). Robinhood templates are the Base ones' shape, not run on a fork.
